pli-tv-bu-vb-pc76:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc76:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ amūlakena saṅghādisesena anuddhaṃsenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc76:1.3: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc76:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ amūlakena saṅghādisesena anuddhaṃsessantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc76:1.5: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ amūlakena saṅghādisesena anuddhaṃsethāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc76:1.8: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā bhikkhuṃ amūlakena saṅghādisesena anuddhaṃsessatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc76:1.9: netaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc76:1.10: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc76:1.11.1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ amūlakena saṅghādisesena anuddhaṃseyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc76:2.1.12: codeti vā codāpeti vā āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc76:2.2.1: upasampanne upasampannasaññī amūlakena saṅghādisesena anuddhaṃseti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc76:2.2.2: upasampanne vematiko amūlakena saṅghādisesena anuddhaṃseti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc76:2.2.3: upasampanne anupasampannasaññī amūlakena saṅghādisesena anuddhaṃseti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc76:2.2.4: ācāravipattiyā vā diṭṭhivipattiyā vā anuddhaṃseti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
